summary: Ansible 9 collection renames: community.sap becomes community.sap_libs (old one removed in Ansible 10), ibm.spectrum_virtualize becomes ibm.storage_virtualize (redirects in 10, removed in 12), and t_systems_mms.icinga_director becomes telekom_mms.icinga_director (removed in 11); update FQCNs.
questions: What is the new name of ibm.spectrum_virtualize?

answer_card.title: Renamed collections (Ansible 9)
answer_card.answer_md:
| Old | New | Old name removed in |
|---|---|---|
| `community.sap` | `community.sap_libs` | Ansible 10 |
| `ibm.spectrum_virtualize` | `ibm.storage_virtualize` | Ansible 12 (redirects from 10) |
| `t_systems_mms.icinga_director` | `telekom_mms.icinga_director` | Ansible 11 |

Update your FQCNs to the new names.
